name: io.github.rundeckpro/rundeck-mcp
description: Rundeck MCP server — exposes Rundeck documentation, API access, and job/runner management tools to AI assistants.

environmentVariables.name: RUNDECK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Rundeck instance (e.g. https://rundeck.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: RUNDECK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Rundeck API token — generate from User Profile → API Tokens in the Rundeck UI

environmentVariables.name: SKIP_RUNDECK_DOCS_DOWNLOAD
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip automatic doc download on install

environmentVariables.name: RUNDECK_DOCS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local Rundeck docs directory (optional — docs are auto-downloaded if omitted)
